description: Polyphonic stereo waveshaper with eight shapes, from gentle overdrive to wave folding and bit crushing, oversampled to keep aliasing out and switchable between AC and DC coupled outputs

params.text: Picks the shape: Smooth for a tube-like asymmetric curve, Clip for hard clipping, Emitter Coupled for 3080 chip saturation, Full Wave and Half Wave rectifiers, Fold and Fold 2 folders, and Crush
Boosts the signal going into the shaper, which is what brings on the shaping and distortion; on the rectifier shapes it only changes the level
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Gain jack before it is added to the gain knob
Shifts the signal before the shaper, which brings in even harmonics, and passes it untouched at centre; on Smooth it sets asymmetry instead, with none at the bottom of its travel
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the offset jack before it is added to the offset knob
Picks the oversampling: 16X for aliasing that is hard to measure, 4X for most of that at a quarter of the work, and 1X for none, which is right for shaping control voltages and for deliberate grit
Switches the outputs between AC, which runs them through 20Hz highpass filters to strip the DC an asymmetric shape makes, and DC, which leaves those filters out so control voltages keep their offset

inputs.text: The left channel's audio; patched on its own it is shaped once and sent to both outputs
The right channel's audio, shaped with the same settings
Drives the gain through the trim knob above it, which is where an envelope goes for a swept folder
Shifts the offset through the trim knob above it

notes: on the Crush shape the gain knob sets the bit depth, from 16 bits down to one bit as it is turned up
a channel uses no CPU at all until both its input and its output are patched
the two trim knobs come up at centre, so a cable at the Gain or offset input changes nothing until the trim above it is turned off centre
